title: tests/test_board_browser.py::test_the_page_works_in_chromium fails locally
notes: Seen 2026-11-24 while running the suite for unrelated work; failure output was not kept. Next step: run this one test alone and record the assertion or the browser error.
evidence: Two causes. On macOS @sparticuz/chromium unpacks a Linux binary (spawn ENOEXEC): the test now skips off Linux unless CHROME_PATH is set. With a real Chromium it failed about 1 run in 5 because the script typed the title before the dialog's own requestAnimationFrame focus moved focus to the first field; the script now waits for that focus. 15 of 15 runs pass with CHROME_PATH set to the Playwright Chromium (pytest -m node -n 0 tests/test_board_browser.py).
